rationale: Three sensors (door_back, motion_living, win_bed) dropped simultaneously while the base station remains online with a healthy uplink and other devices of the same models still online. The base station log shows E-610 (radio module self-test warning), which the fault-code reference explicitly flags as a sub-GHz radio failure requiring escalation. Batteries are healthy (66-81%) and RSSI is null, ruling out weak signal/battery causes; the customer's Wi-Fi router theory is inconsistent with the sub-GHz sensor link.

output.symptom_summary: Three sensors (Back Door, Living Motion, Bedroom Window) went offline simultaneously while the base station and other devices remain online. Customer suspects Wi-Fi router interference, but sensors use sub-GHz.
output.suspected_root_cause: Base station sub-GHz radio module failure indicated by E-610 self-test warning.
key_abnormal_indicators: Base station error code E-610 (radio module self-test warning)
Three sensors offline simultaneously (door_back, motion_living, win_bed)
Offline sensors have healthy batteries (66-81%) and null RSSI
Other devices including same-model sensors remain online
output.customer_reply: Thank you for the details. Our diagnostics indicate a hardware issue with the base station's radio module, not your Wi-Fi router. I've escalated your case to our engineering team, who will contact you within 24 hours to arrange a replacement. We apologize for the inconvenience.

results.text: Three sensors in different rooms went offline at the same minute; base station online, RSSI history normal, E-610 in log. Restarting did not help. Escalated; radio module replaced. Escalated correctly.
Logged by the base station when its sub-GHz radio fails self-test or multiple peripherals drop simultaneously. Always escalate to FAE.
All devices offline, base station LED solid red. Router had been replaced the previous day and the Ethernet cable was in the wrong port. Resolved at frontline.

complaint: Several devices dropped at once although the base station is still online. Around breakfast the app showed the garden door sensor, the living room motion sensor and the bedroom window sensor as offline. I moved the Wi-Fi router about 2 m last week, so I assume the new position is causing interference. Everything else is working.
